# catalog-ledger fixtures

Inputs to `scripts/catalog-ledger-test.sh`. The names and digests are synthetic. The `.toml`
files here are inert: nothing outside `daemon/` loads them.

## Ledgers, compared against `base.ledger` unless stated

- `base.ledger`: two active entries, the baseline.
- `appended.ledger`: base plus `gamma.three`. Passes.
- `withdrawn.ledger`: `beta.two` marked withdrawn. Passes (a withdrawal is allowed).
- `changed-body.ledger`: `beta.two` has another digest. Fails; the committed failing fixture.
- `changed-class.ledger`: `beta.two` has another risk class. Fails.
- `dropped.ledger`: `beta.two` removed. Fails.
- `reordered.ledger`: the two entries swapped. Fails.
- `readded-flip.ledger`: `beta.two` active again; compared against `withdrawn.ledger`. Fails.
- `readded-append.ledger`: `withdrawn.ledger` plus a new active `beta.two` line; compared against
  `withdrawn.ledger`. Refused as malformed (a name appears once).
- `malformed-comment.ledger`: a trailing `# note` on an entry. Refused as malformed.

The CRLF case is generated by the test, so no checkout setting can normalise it away.

## `templates/`, each a stand-in for `templates.d`, checked against `base.ledger`

- `ok/`: two Templates, one with a slot named `unit`, which is never read as a Template name. Passes.
- `unledgered/`: `ok/` plus `gamma.three`, which has no ledger entry. Fails.
- `spaced-header/`, `indented-header/`, `inline-array/`, `literal-name/`, `multiline-body/`,
  `other-header/`: catalog layouts the check does not read. Each is refused as unreadable.
- `empty/`: a catalog with no Template. Refused as unreadable.
- `extra-pack/`: `ok/` plus `site/extra.toml`, a second pack file. Refused as unreadable.
- `no-catalog/`: only `site/extra.toml`. Refused as unreadable.
